items.title: Alvin Alcorn and Eddie Marrero Interview, 1979-12-04
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I saw Lawrence and Faiso wanted to fight in a sort of a visit... Dream I had.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. And I told you, Eddie, go look for Lawrence.

ctx.s: Alvin Alcorn (co-interviewee / Marrero family member, NOT interviewer)
ctx.x: I saw Lawrence and Faiso wanted to fight in a sort of a visit... Dream I had. By Tom? You're right. And you were sitting by a fireplace. Well, look.
That's what I'm telling you. You know what you did, boy, man?
